risk_if_not_implemented: Without Restrict Tool Usage, maintenance activities may introduce unauthorized changes, expose systems to untrusted personnel or tools, or leave systems in an unsafe state. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), Unauthorized Privilege Elevation (R-AC-3), Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14).

compensating_control_1.name: Integrity Assurance & Enforcement (IAE)
compensating_control_1.description:
Automated mechanisms exist to:
(1) Identify unauthorized deviations from an approved secure baseline configuration; and
(2) Implement automated resiliency actions to remediate the unauthorized change.
compensating_control_1.justification: Integrity Assurance & Enforcement (IAE) (CFG-08.2) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Restrict Tool Usage (MNT-11.3) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Restrict Tool Usage (MNT-11.3) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
